% An article with lists of its packages, beside each list of an earlier
% build and its .aux, which names them in \@writefile lines: the list of
% figures, which tex4ht reads through the .4ct, tocloft's \newlistof,
% float's \newfloat, newfloat's \DeclareFloatingEnvironment, listings'
% list, and algorithm's list. The earlier build had no entries: each list
% holds only an \addtocontents write of \oldmark, which this document
% does not define, and tocloft's list also a line of text written with
% \addtocontents, so only the .aux shows it is a list. The stale files
% stay as they are.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{tocloft}
\newcommand{\listexamplename}{Examples}
\newlistof{example}{lop}{\listexamplename}
\newcommand{\example}[1]{\refstepcounter{example}\par\noindent Example~\theexample: #1%
  \addcontentsline{lop}{example}{\protect\numberline{\theexample}#1}\par}
\usepackage{float}
\newfloat{program}{h}{lpr}
\floatname{program}{Program}
\usepackage{newfloat}
\DeclareFloatingEnvironment[fileext=lsc]{scheme}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage{listings}
\usepackage{algorithm}
\begin{document}
\listoffigures
\listofexample
\listof{program}{List of Programs}
\listofschemes
\lstlistoflistings
\listofalgorithms
\section{First}
Text of the first section.
\begin{figure}[h]
\centering A figure.
\caption{New figure}
\end{figure}
\example{A new example}
\begin{program}
A program.
\caption{New program}
\end{program}
\begin{scheme}[h]
A scheme.
\caption{New scheme}
\end{scheme}
\begin{lstlisting}[caption={New listing}]
x = 1
\end{lstlisting}
\begin{algorithm}[h]
An algorithm.
\caption{New algorithm}
\end{algorithm}
\end{document}
